item.title: ফুটবল বিশ্বের সবচেয়ে মূল্যবান ভ্রাতৃপ্রতিম জুটি
item.description: ফুটবল জগতে অনেক ভাই একসঙ্গে খেলেছেন, যাদের সম্মিলিত বাজারমূল্য প্রায় ২৯,৪৯০ কোটি টাকা। শৈশবের সেই উঠান থেকে শুরু করে পেশাদার ক্যারিয়ার পর্যন্ত তাদের এই পথচলা ক্রীড়াঙ্গনে অনন্য এক ইতিহাস তৈরি করেছে।

item.title: Delhi Air Quality Drops to Hazardous Levels Amid Deepavali Firework Restrictions Defiance
item.description: Atmospheric contamination exceeded recommended World Health Organization thresholds by more than 50 times in several locations across Delhi as residents ignored prohibitions on pyrotechnics during Deepavali. Consequently, overall air readings remained at "very poor" levels, with numerous districts experiencing "severe" pollution.

item.title: Morning Digest: Delhi air quality, stranded seafarers and updates
item.description: Delhi's air pollution worsened after Diwali despite restrictions on fireworks. Meanwhile, nineteen Indian sailors trapped in Yemen were successfully rescued and brought home.

item.title: Brent crude drops past $1 on Trump's comments about Iran
item.description: Global oil prices dropped by over a dollar on Monday following Donald Trump's indication that new US military strikes against Iran remain improbable. Market anxiety persists regarding geopolitical stability despite his diplomatic remarks.

item.title: Ex-officer Beau Lamarre-Condon testifies in Sydney murder trial
item.description: Accused ex-police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon reenacted a shooting while testifying in a New South Wales court. He has entered a not-guilty plea for the 2024 murders of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies.

item.title: Khor Mor gasfield halts operations after drone strike in Iraq
item.description: A drone assault forced a production stoppage at Iraq's Khor Mor gas facility. Consequently, over seventy percent of the Kurdish region in northern Iraq lost electricity.

item.title: ৯ নভেম্বর ২০২৬: টিভিতে আজকের খেলাধুলা
item.description: আজ সিলেট টেস্টের শেষ দিন এবং রাওয়ালপিন্ডিতে পাকিস্তান ও শ্রীলঙ্কার প্রথম টেস্ট শুরু হচ্ছে। এছাড়া অনূর্ধ্ব-১৯ এশিয়া কাপ ক্রিকেটে বাংলাদেশের প্রতিপক্ষ মালয়েশিয়া।

item.title: বদরুল সাহেবের রাজনৈতিক পরিচয়ের পরিবর্তন
item.description: রাজনীতিতে পরিচিত মুখ বদরুল সাহেব অতীতে এক দলের অন্ধ ভক্ত ছিলেন এবং সামাজিক মাধ্যমে বিরোধীদের তীব্র সমালোচনা করতেন। দলীয় ফোরামে নিজ দলের নেতাদের দেশের সূর্য এবং প্রতিপক্ষকে অন্ধকার বলে আখ্যায়িত করতেন তিনি।

item.title: কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা যুগে মানব অনুবাদের প্রয়োজনীয়তা
item.description: ফরাসি প্রবাদের মতো আলংকারিক ভাষার অন্তর্নিহিত অর্থ ধরতে কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা প্রায়ই হিমশিম খায়। তাই মানুষের বুদ্ধিমত্তা ও অনুভূতির মূল্যায়ন অনুবাদের ক্ষেত্রে এখনও অপরিহার্য রয়েছে।

item.title: ভিশন বোর্ড ও ইতিবাচক চিন্তার ট্রেন্ড
item.description: দৈনন্দিন জীবনে ভিশন বোর্ড তৈরি এবং ইতিবাচক চিন্তার মাধ্যমে জীবন বদলানোর চর্চা এখন বেশ জনপ্রিয় হয়ে উঠেছে। তরুণ প্রজন্ম এসব পদ্ধতির মাধ্যমে নিজেদের ইচ্ছা ও স্বপ্ন পূরণে উদ্বুদ্ধ হচ্ছে।

item.title: নবম শ্রেণির ছাত্রের অভিনয়ে দর্শক আবেগপ্রবণ
item.description: গত বৃহস্পতিবার রাতে রাজশাহীর বাঘা উপজেলার অমরপুর গ্রামে ‘গরিবের আর্তনাদ’ নামের একটি সামাজিক যাত্রাপালা মঞ্চস্থ হয়। এতে নবম শ্রেণির ছাত্র মাসুমের অভিনয় দেখে দর্শকেরা আবেগপ্রবণ হয়ে পড়েন।

item.title: মুম্বাইয়ের ডংরিতে আগুন, নিয়ন্ত্রণে কাজ চলছে
item.description: মুম্বাইয়ের ডংরিতে একটি ভয়াবহ অগ্নিকাণ্ডের ঘটনা ঘটেছে। আগুন নেভাতে ফায়ার সার্ভিসের পাশাপাশি পুলিশ ও অন্যান্য জরুরি সেবা সংস্থার কর্মীরা কাজ করছেন।

item.title: Air Quality Control Body Implements Anti-Pollution Measures in Delhi Area Ahead of Diwali
item.description: The Commission for Air Quality Management initiated Stage 3 protocols under the Graded Response Action Plan throughout Delhi and surrounding regions prior to Diwali. This measure came as atmospheric pollution levels soared close to an Air Quality Index reading of 400.

item.title: চীনা চর সন্দেহে এনভিডিয়া প্রধানের তদন্ত শুরু
item.description: চীনা গোয়েন্দাদের তথ্য সংগ্রহকারী সন্দেহভাজন এক নারী নির্বাহীর সঙ্গে সম্পর্কের কথা বোর্ডকে জানানোর পর তদন্ত শুরু করেছে এনভিডিয়া। মার্কিন গোয়েন্দারা ওই নারীকে নিয়ে এ তথ্য দিয়েছিলেন।

item.title: আ Antalya-য় জলবায়ু ও ভূরাজনীতির চাপের মধ্যে COP31 শুরু
item.description: তুরস্কের আন্তালিয়া সিটির বিশাল প্রদর্শনী কেন্দ্রে জলবায়ু সম্মেলন COP31 শুরু হয়েছে। আগামী দুই সপ্তাহে এই আয়োজনে এক লাখেরও বেশি মানুষের সমাগম ঘটবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে।

item.title: স্ত্রীর কাছে ক্ষমা চেয়ে এনভিডিয়া প্রধানের চিঠি
item.description: স্ত্রীর সঙ্গে বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা করার কথা স্বীকার করে কোম্পানির কর্মীদের কাছে চিঠি পাঠিয়েছেন এনভিডিয়া প্রধান জেনসেন হুয়াং। নিজের কাজের জন্য তিনি স্ত্রী ও সন্তানদের কাছে গভীরভাবে দুঃখ প্রকাশ করেছেন।

item.title: ডব্লিউডব্লিউতে নারী হত্যা মামলায় পরিবারের সদস্যরা অভিযুক্ত
item.description: নিউ সাউথ ওয়েলসের আঞ্চলিক এলাকায় একাধিক ছুরিকাঘাতে ড্যানিয়েল ম্যাডউইক নিহত হন। এই গার্হস্থ্য সহিংসতা হত্যাকাণ্ডে অভিযুক্ত ব্যক্তির পরিবারের সদস্যদের বিরুদ্ধে অপরাধে সহায়তার অভিযোগ আনা হয়েছে।

item.title: শ্বেতা তিওয়ারির ফিটনেস ও সুশৃঙ্খল খাদ্যাভ্যাস
item.description: নিয়মিত শরীরচর্চা, সাইক্লিং এবং সাঁতারের মাধ্যমে ফিটনেস বজায় রাখেন শ্বেতা তিওয়ারি। তার প্রশিক্ষক জানিয়েছেন যে, সঠিক ডায়েট ও নিয়মিত ব্যায়ামের মাধ্যমেই তিনি এই রুটিন বজায় রাখেন।

item.title: India Retains Three Pacers for Red-Ball Training Camp
item.description: Arshdeep Singh, Gurnoor Brar, and Auqib Nabi will remain with the team to assist with upcoming Test match preparations. Batting coach Sitanshu Kotak noted that the recent one-day matches offered useful practice ahead of the red-ball fixtures.

item.title: Bengaluru Mother Applies Lipstick During Childbirth
item.description: Myra Sharma applied lipstick while in labor to stay distracted and cope with the physical discomfort. She noted that this small activity helped her maintain her personal identity, while recognizing that birth experiences differ for everyone.

item.title: Congress Condemns 'Dimagi Naxal' Statement as an Attack
item.description: The Congress party has strongly criticized the use of the term 'Dimagi Naxal', labeling the remark as a severe and direct assault.

item.title: Delhi Air Quality Reaches Severe Level on Diwali
item.description: Pollution levels in Delhi worsened significantly overnight, with the Central Pollution Control Board recording an AQI of 406 at ITO. The hazardous conditions led to a notable drop in visibility across the city.

item.title: Guide to Using an Extra Laptop as an Additional Screen
item.description: Users can repurpose an idle laptop into a secondary display by linking it to a primary computer using either a wired or wireless connection.

item.title: Pontiff Advises Argentine President on Economy and Welfare
item.description: Pope Leo XIV sent a message to President Javier Milei emphasizing the protection of democracy and urging that financial policies support impoverished citizens amidst austerity measures.

item.title: Karnataka Inspects Fuel Samples at 67 Sites Over Ethanol Issues
item.description: Chief Minister Shivakumar stated that authorities conducted checks at 67 spots, covering both retail fuel stations and the supply and ethanol blending phases.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Admits Affair Linked to Probe
item.description: In an email statement, Jensen Huang confessed to an extramarital relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. He apologized to his relatives and staff, and pledged full assistance to ongoing investigations.

item.title: Rubio defends military campaign against Iran amid domestic economic pressure
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended the ongoing military conflict with Iran, acknowledging it lacks broad popularity but is necessary to halt nuclear ambitions. Citizens have faced financial strain and rising fuel costs due to supply interruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Actor Kajal Aggarwal posts behind-the-scenes photos as Mandodari
item.description: Kajal Aggarwal published backstage images portraying Mandodari in the movie 'Ramayana: The Rise of a Legend'. She thanked fans for appreciating her role and the cinematic project, which utilizes modern technology.

item.title: Australia selectors drop Marnus Labuschagne from upcoming Test matches against New Zealand
item.description: Chief selector George Bailey announced that Marnus Labuschagne has been removed from the Australia Test squad. The decision follows a prolonged slump in his batting performance at the number three position.

item.title: Indian stock market indexes close Muhurat trading lower for the first time in eight years
item.description: Both the Sensex and Nifty indices finished the special Muhurat trading session in negative territory. This marks the initial decline for the holiday trading event since 2017.

item.title: Nvidia probes CEO Jensen Huang following relationship with alleged Chinese intelligence operative
item.description: Chief Executive Jensen Huang acknowledged infidelity and confirmed he is assisting a security inquiry. Nvidia has initiated a formal investigation into the matter.

item.title: Troubleshooting guide for unrecognised USB accessories connected to Apple laptops
item.description: MacBook users experiencing connection failures with USB hardware can investigate potential causes ranging from faulty cables to system software glitches. The article outlines methods to resolve these connectivity issues.

item.title: Fatal Train Crash in Egyptian Governorate
item.description: An accident involving a train in the Al-Ayyat region of Giza resulted in four fatalities and left 88 individuals injured, prompting an official inquiry.

item.title: Diwali celebrations illuminate communities across India
item.description: India observed the major Hindu holiday with traditional prayers, illumination, and pyrotechnics. Festivities were held nationwide to mark the occasion.

item.title: Meryl Streep discussed the value of personal uniqueness during a 2014 speech
item.description: In a 2014 academic address, actor Meryl Streep emphasized that personal distinctiveness is a strength instead of a flaw. Using her encounters with criticism, she underscored the importance of authenticity despite external judgment.

item.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 Nears 70 Crore Globally
item.description: Venkatesh's movie maintained strong ticket sales over its initial ten days. Its domestic net reached Rs. 45.45 crore, pushing global earnings near Rs. 70 crore.

item.title: Melbourne Resident Charged With Murder of Delivery Courier
item.description: A man from Footscray has been criminally charged following the fatal stabbing of 47-year-old delivery worker Feng Jianming in central Melbourne on Friday.

item.title: Breaking Bad Cast Gathers for RJ Mitte Memorial
item.description: Relatives and colleagues gathered to honor late actor RJ Mitte at Hope Lutheran Church, followed by a reception in Hollywood. Several former Breaking Bad cast members attended the memorial.

item.title: Trump Pledges Return Amid Midterm Fallout and Investigations
item.description: Following Republican midterm losses, Donald Trump promised a political return on Sunday. Meanwhile, incoming Democrats vowed investigations into his administration, and the attorney general pledged support for officials.

item.title: ইরাকের খোর মোরে ড্রোন হামলায় গ্যাস উৎপাদন স্থগিত
item.description: রোববার সুলাইমানিয়া প্রদেশের খোর মোর গ্যাসক্ষেত্রে ড্রোন হামলার ঘটনা ঘটে। এই হামলার ফলে গ্যাসক্ষেত্রটির উৎপাদন স্থগিত হয়ে যাওয়ায় বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদনে বিঘ্ন ঘটেছে।

item.title: Canon 3D Photo Software Compatibility Guide
item.description: Canon cameras are recognized for working well with various applications. They function best when paired with the manufacturer's complimentary 3D photography software.

item.title: Delhi Air Quality Reaches Very Poor Levels Post-Diwali
item.description: Delhi residents faced severe pollution on Monday morning following Diwali celebrations. Multiple neighborhoods registered an Air Quality Index reading above 400, bringing the overall AQI to 376.

item.title: Democrats Plan Investigations and Hegseth Impeachment
item.description: Democratic representatives are planning their legislative priorities following the midterms. Their agenda includes committee probes targeting Trump and backing an impeachment against Hegseth.

item.title: Nvidia launches probe following reports involving CEO Huang
item.description: Nvidia announced an independent review on Sunday after publications stated that CEO Jensen Huang was the focus of foreign intelligence operations. Reports alleged he maintained ties with a Chinese businesswoman suspected of aiding Beijing.

item.title: Mookuthi Amman 2 Crosses Rs. 8 Crore in India by Day 3
item.description: Starring Nayanthara, Mookuthi Amman 2 performed strongly during its opening weekend with an 87.8% jump in Sunday collections. The feature surpassed Rs. 8 crore in domestic net earnings within three days.

item.title: Drishyam 3 Reaches Rs 587 Crore Globally on Day 37
item.description: Ajay Devgn's Hindi movie Drishyam 3: The Conclusion has accumulated Rs 587.52 crore worldwide. On its 37th day in theaters, the feature experienced a rise in daily ticket sales, demonstrating sustained viewer engagement.

item.title: Khor Mor Gas Facility Struck by Drone in Northern Iraq
item.description: An unmanned aerial vehicle attacked the Khor Mor gas plant in Iraq. The strike resulted in power outages affecting over 70 percent of the country's northern Kurdish region.

item.title: Chinese Espionage Investigation Triggered by Nvidia Chief's Affair
item.description: Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has acknowledged having a romantic relationship with an individual suspected of conducting espionage for China. This admission has led to an official investigation.

item.title: Drawbacks Associated With Purchasing Technology Abroad
item.description: Importing electronic devices such as laptops and phones allows consumers to obtain items not locally available. However, this practice comes with several distinct disadvantages.

item.title: Abducted Mayor of Rio Bravo Released in Zacatecas
item.description: The mayor of Rio Bravo was liberated by kidnappers following an abduction in the Zacatecas region. The area is frequently impacted by violence linked to drug cartels.

item.title: Charities Offer Guidance on Reducing Holiday Spending
item.description: Charitable organizations advise that minor financial choices made today can significantly impact holiday budgets. Implementing these budgeting strategies can help reduce festive expenses.

item.title: Chandra and Mehli Meet Again at Tata Headquarters
item.description: Amid developments involving Noel, Chandra and Mehli reunited at the main Tata offices. The encounter brought the two figures together at the corporate headquarters.

item.title: Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss Attend Chiefs Match
item.description: Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss attended a Kansas City Chiefs football match together over the weekend. Their joint appearance surprised supporters who had suspected a lingering disagreement between them.

item.title: Medic having meal near Krakow attack credited with saving officer
item.description: A medical professional eating near the scene of a shooting close to Krakow likely kept an officer alive, a peer stated. New information has surfaced about two officers praised for stopping a gunman from harming more people.

item.title: Match of the Day analysts examine defensive errors by Manchester United
item.description: Following four avoidable goals conceded against Aston Villa, pundits Dion Dublin and Leon Osman analyzed Manchester United's backline vulnerabilities on television.

item.title: Ten Apple devices and capabilities developed during Tim Cook's tenure
item.description: Throughout a 15-year period under Chief Executive Officer Tim Cook, Apple introduced numerous device transformations and hardware expansions.

item.title: German Chancellor Merz plans to put forward Aigner for presidency
item.description: Bavarian state parliament speaker Ilse Aigner, a member of the Christian Social Union, is slated for nomination as Germany's initial female president.

item.title: Ramayana adaptation nears five hundred crore global box office mark
item.description: Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and starring Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, the feature film neared five hundred crore globally after four days in theaters.

item.title: Prime Minister Modi remarks that ideological instigators remain active
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that while left-wing extremism has declined, ideological agitators continue to provoke citizens.

item.title: Lando Norris performs strongly in Sao Paulo despite pyrotechnic incident
item.description: Lando Norris delivered an exceptional driving performance at the demanding Sao Paulo Grand Prix, notwithstanding a close brush with a pyrotechnic.
